integrity.disclosureTitle: What is recorded during this quiz
integrity.disclosureRecorded: While the quiz is open, these are recorded with the time they happened: switching to another tab or window, leaving full screen, copying, pasting and printing on this page, and a connection check once a minute. Your reviewer sees them with plain explanations — they are prompts for a conversation, not proof of anything.
integrity.disclosureMonitor: You will not be interrupted. The record is shown to your reviewer with your attempt.
integrity.disclosureWarn: You will be warned each time one is recorded. The limit is {{count}}; reaching it flags the attempt for review.
integrity.disclosureStrict: You will be warned each time one is recorded. When {{count}} have been recorded, the quiz is submitted automatically with the answers you have saved.
integrity.disclosureFullscreen: This quiz opens in full screen when you press Start. If you leave full screen, the questions are hidden until you return — your answers and the timer are kept — and leaving is recorded. If your browser can’t use full screen, you can still take the quiz; your instructor will see that it wasn’t available.
integrity.disclosureHonest: Atlas never uses your camera or microphone, never records your screen or what you type, and sees nothing outside this page. Nothing is blocked.
integrity.acknowledge: I understand what is recorded during this quiz.
integrity.bannerWarn: {{count}} event has been recorded on this attempt. Stay on this page until you submit.

protection.title: What is actually protecting this lesson

badge.openDetails: Show what is protecting this lesson

protection.expiresIn: The link on this page stops working in about {{minutes}} minutes, and is replaced automatically while you watch.
protection.externalNotice: The academy links to this content rather than hosting it, so none of the measures below apply to it.

signedUrl.yes: Your access is checked before this content is handed over.
signedUrl.no: The academy does not check access to this content.

boundToSession.yes: The delivery service re-checks your sign-in on every request.
boundToSession.no: The delivery service does not re-check your sign-in once playback has started.

boundToDevice.yes: The delivery service re-checks this device on every request.
boundToDevice.no: Playback is not tied to this device: the link would work on another device until it expires.

revocable.yes: Access can be withdrawn immediately, before the link expires.
revocable.no: Access cannot be withdrawn before the link expires.

originRestricted.yes: Playback is restricted to this academy’s own websites.
originRestricted.no: Playback is not restricted to this academy’s websites.

watermark.yes: Your account is shown over the video.
watermark.no: No watermark is drawn over this content.

protection.noDrm: There is no DRM. Nothing here prevents screen recording.
protection.limits: No content can be made impossible to copy. These measures check who you are and keep links short-lived; they do not stop screen recording, and the academy does not claim they do.
